_comment: Tip: run `node run.mjs --setup` to fill this out interactively. This file NEVER leaves your machine. dateOfBirth/ssn are optional — include them only if you accept them sitting on disk (chmod 600); otherwise leave blank and type them by hand when the agent pauses at the identity step.
_business_comment: Business (KYB) fields — only used for business-account offers. Fill these if you're harvesting business checking bonuses. EIN is sensitive like the SSN; include it only if you accept it sitting on disk (chmod 600).
